title: Bottle Listing From One Photo
tests: Tests turning one attached product photo into three finished listing images while preserving the source product's identity.

faults.what: The white-background image changes the lid handle into a single open arch, removing the central vertical section visible in the reference and the other outputs.

The bottle is re-rendered rather than faithfully preserved: the white-background shot and close-up have stronger, glossier highlights, and the close-up introduces a pronounced pebbled surface texture not visible in the original matte finish.
The base grooves are more pronounced and regular in the generated full-bottle shots than in the reference.

judge.summary: Three well-composed square listing images were produced, but changes to the lid and surface finish prevent them from faithfully representing the exact bottle.

must_haves.item: There are three separate square images, not a collage.
must_haves.why: The outputs are three individual square images.

must_haves.item: The bottle in every image matches the attached photo's silhouette, proportions, lid and matte black finish.
must_haves.why: The general silhouette is similar, but the white-background image changes the handle construction, and the finish becomes glossier and more textured in the white shot and close-up.

must_haves.item: The white-background image shows the entire bottle with the original wooden table removed.
must_haves.why: The entire bottle is visible against white with a subtle grounding shadow and no wooden table.

must_haves.item: The lifestyle image places the bottle convincingly on a gym bench.
must_haves.why: The bottle sits on a padded gym bench with plausible contact and a recognizable gym environment.

must_haves.item: The close-up clearly shows the lid and matte surface without inventing new product features.
must_haves.why: The lid is clearly framed, but the pronounced pebbled texture and shinier surface do not faithfully preserve the reference finish.

must_haves.item: No added text or branding appears.
must_haves.why: No text or branding is visible in any output.
